## PresenceSimulatorBackend.getCapabilities() method

Report this instance's scripted `BackendCapabilities`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getCapabilities(): Promise<BackendCapabilities>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;[BackendCapabilities](./vaultkeeper.backendcapabilities.md)<!-- -->&gt;

## Remarks

An operation reports as presence-covered (included in `presenceEnforcedOperations`<!-- -->) when its scripted outcome is `'grant'` or `'refuse'` — both mean this instance \*does\* force a fresh per-use action for that operation, one that succeeds and one that gets declined. An operation scripted `'not-capable'` is omitted, so vaultkeeper's own fail-closed enforcement refuses a `requirePresencePerUse` request for it with `NotCapableError` before this backend is ever touched. When every operation is `'not-capable'` (the default), this reports `presencePerUse: false` outright.
